Market today: The market's feeling the squeeze from rising 10-year Treasury yields hitting 5%, a major headwind for growth stocks like your tech/chip names. Adding to that, "AI doomsday fears" are creating uncertainty, directly impacting your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are leveraged ETFs with deep losses and "SELL" status; their default stops need immediate review. SMH (-14.91%) is also marked "TRIM" and is dangerously close to its stop at 540. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a sharp eye on the upcoming Fed meeting for any signals on interest rates, and monitor the evolving sentiment around AI.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management for your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions.
plays: SMH: Your stop at 540 is critical; respect it immediately as the price is just above, given the current market headwinds.
SOXL & SPAL: Review and adjust the stops on these leveraged, decaying ETFs; their deep losses demand active risk management.
SOXS: Consider a tactical long on SOXS (entry 50.55-50.5, stop 50.07) as a potential hedge against your concentrated chip exposure, given AI fears and China tech controls.
